_meta.note: Coordinates were geocoded on 2026-09-13 via OpenStreetMap Nominatim (free, no key) against real map features (beach/attraction nodes where possible). coordsVerified:true means a specific point feature was matched (e.g. a mapped beach or landmark) — still worth a quick glance on Google Maps before the trip. coordsVerified:false means the match was a broader area (village/admin centroid or an averaged multi-point site) and should be tightened with a real Google Maps long-press before relying on it for geo-triggers.

pois.name: Ramla Bay (Ramla il-Ħamra)
pois.coordsNote: Center of the two mapped swimming-area halves of the beach.

pois.name: San Blas Bay
pois.coordsNote: Mapped beach node near Nadur.

pois.name: Ħondoq ir-Rummien
pois.coordsNote: Mapped beach node — corrects an earlier placeholder that was ~2 km off.

pois.name: Wied il-Għasri
pois.coordsNote: Mapped beach node at the mouth of the gorge.

pois.name: Dwejra (Inland Sea & Blue Hole)
pois.coordsNote: Averaged between the Azure Window site and the Dwejra parking area — the whole heritage park spans a few hundred meters (Inland Sea, Blue Hole, Fungus Rock are all separate spots). Worth pinning the exact parking/entry point on Google Maps.

pois.name: Mġarr ix-Xini
pois.coordsNote: Mapped beach node at the inlet.

pois.name: Xlendi Bay
pois.coordsNote: Mapped beach node — corrects an earlier placeholder that was ~1.6 km off.

pois.name: Marsalforn
pois.coordsNote: Village centroid, not the specific promenade/beach — fine for a compact village but worth nudging toward the seafront if you want the trigger closer to the water.

pois.name: Ġgantija Temples
pois.coordsNote: Mapped temple site/attraction node.

pois.name: Cittadella, Victoria
pois.coordsNote: Mapped Cittadella node in Rabat/Victoria.

pois.name: Qala Belvedere
pois.coordsNote: Matched 'Ġnien il-Belveder' (Belvedere Garden) directly — corrects an earlier placeholder that was ~1 km off.

pois.name: Comino — Blue Lagoon & Crystal Lagoon
pois.coordsNote: Mapped tourism attraction point between Comino and Cominotto (the Blue Lagoon channel).

pois.name: St Peter's Pool, Malta
pois.coordsNote: Matched 'Il-Kalanka tal-Qali', the local name for the St Peter's Pool bay — corrects an earlier placeholder that was ~600 m off.

pois.name: Marsaxlokk, Malta
pois.coordsNote: Administrative village centroid, not specifically the harbour front — fine given the village is compact and walkable, but nudge toward the water if you want the trigger right at the luzzu boats.

pois.name: Calypso's Cave
pois.coordsNote: OSM natural=cave_entrance node, western side of Ramla bay (has a Wikipedia/Wikidata entry).

pois.name: Ramla Bay Roman Villa
pois.coordsNote: OSM historic=archaeological_site node (Villa Rumana tar-Ramla l-Hamra). No dedicated Wikipedia article, but the site is referenced in Wikipedia's list of Roman public baths as the Xaghra Ramla l-Hamra Roman Baths. Only ~130-170m from ramla_bay/belancourt_battery, so it will often trigger alongside them — expected given how close these really are on the ground.

pois.name: Belancourt Battery
pois.coordsNote: OSM historic=fort node. Officially 'Ramla Left Battery', also known as Belancourt or Xaghra Battery. Only ~47m from roman_villa and ~130-170m from ramla_bay — expected overlap given the real-world clustering.

pois.name: Fungus Rock
pois.coordsNote: OSM tourism=attraction node (Il-Ġebla tal-Ġeneral), matches Wikipedia coordinates for Fungus Rock.

pois.name: Azure Window (collapsed)
pois.coordsNote: OSM tourism=attraction node with wikipedia=en:Azure Window tag. Only ~112m from dwejra, so it will usually trigger alongside it — expected given how close they really are.

pois.name: Wolseley Battery
pois.coordsNote: OSM historic=castle node with wikipedia=en:Wolseley Battery tag, near St Peter's Pool.

pois.name: Tas-Salvatur (Risen Christ statue)
pois.coordsNote: OSM historic=memorial node (statue), above Marsalforn.

pois.name: Marsalforn Tower (site)
pois.coordsNote: Coordinates from the Wikipedia infobox for Marsalforn Tower. About 490m from the marsalforn POI, so treat it as part of that cluster rather than walkable from Ramla right now.
